entries.27b9de7b91e0a952: This business covers vending machines and equipment used in stores. In addition to beverage vending machines and food and goods vending machines, it handles store equipment and cash-handling equipment. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, revenue from external customers was ¥105,573 million, segment profit was ¥13,132 million, and the number of employees was 1,825 (excluding 513 temporary employees); it is the smallest of the 4 reportable segments. Revenue from external customers fell from ¥109,261 million in the prior year, the only decline in revenue among the 4 reportable segments. The company explains that in the vending machine field, both revenue and operating profit fell below the prior year due to lower domestic demand for vending machines, and that in the store distribution field there was a reversal of the special demand related to the banknote redesign in the prior year. 'Kaisatsu' refers to the banknote redesign; demand for replacing cash-handling equipment in line with it was concentrated in the prior period.

entries.41b7c03ebf5872bd: This business makes power semiconductors that switch the flow of electricity or change its voltage. The securities report lists only one product item for this segment, 'industrial and automotive power semiconductors'; compared with the other 3 segments, it has a narrower product range and instead focuses deeply on 1 product. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, revenue from external customers was ¥234,253 million, segment profit was ¥23,520 million, and the number of employees was 5,822 (excluding 430 temporary employees). Revenue was roughly flat from ¥233,524 million in the prior year, but segment profit fell by ¥13,561 million from ¥37,081 million in the prior year, the only decline in profit among the 4 reportable segments. The company explains that in the industrial field, revenue exceeded the prior year due to increased demand from China and the effect of exchange rates, while in the electrical components field, revenue fell below the prior year due to lower demand for power semiconductors for electrified vehicles (xEV) and the impact of the price revision in the prior year; profit fell below the prior year due to soaring raw material prices, price competition mainly in the Chinese market in the industrial field, and lower demand in the electrical components field. This business also requires large capital investment; the increase in property, plant and equipment and intangible assets of ¥35,389 million and depreciation of ¥39,388 million in the fiscal year ended March 2026 are both the largest among the 4 reportable segments. In the current period, it also recorded impairment losses of ¥2,947 million; the group's total impairment losses consist only of this segment's amount. The orders received by the semiconductor division of FUJI ELECTRIC CO.,LTD. on a standalone basis are ¥187.7 billion.

entries.5236efd0193a998f: This field handles power receiving and transforming equipment, industrial power supply equipment, energy storage systems, energy management systems, and solar and wind power generation. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, both revenue and operating profit exceeded the prior year due to an increase in energy storage system projects and an increase in large projects for transforming equipment for utilities and industry and for industrial power supply equipment.
entries.5aa9658ecf1d3e4d: This business covers facilities that generate electricity and facilities that distribute and stabilize the electricity produced. It handles thermal, geothermal and hydroelectric power generation equipment, fuel cells and nuclear-related equipment, as well as substation and receiving equipment, industrial power supply equipment, power storage systems, energy management systems, solar and wind power generation, uninterruptible power supplies (UPS), electrical panels, and electrical and air-conditioning construction work. For the fiscal year ended March 2026, revenue from external customers was ¥385,260 million and segment profit was ¥59,506 million, the second largest by revenue but the largest of the four reportable segments by profit. The number of employees was 6,965, excluding 608 temporary employees. In the segment reorganization at the start of the current fiscal year, the equipment construction field was incorporated into this segment, and the company explains that this was aimed at strengthening its systems business. The annual securities report attributes a steady rise in capital expenditure by power, manufacturing and data center operators to GX investment aimed at realizing a decarbonized society and to rising energy demand from the expanded use of generative AI and digital technologies. The order intake of FUJI ELECTRIC CO.,LTD.'s Energy division on a standalone basis was ¥331.1 billion.
entries.675d5b8601601a2b: This field sells components that equipment makers incorporate into their own machines. Items include inverters, motors, servo systems, small power supplies, measuring instruments, sensors, smart meters, controllers and HMIs. For the fiscal year ended March 2026, both revenue and operating profit (loss) exceeded the prior year, mainly due to higher demand for measuring instruments.

For the fiscal year ended March 2026, revenue from external customers was ¥464,353 million, the largest of the four reportable segments; segment profit was ¥44,383 million, and the number of employees was 10,856, excluding 1,054 temporary employees. Revenue from external customers rose sharply from ¥396,679 million in the prior year, and the [[term:annual-securities-report|annual securities report]] attributes this mainly to an increase in large IT solutions projects. Following a segment reorganization at the start of the current fiscal year, the Equipment field, which had been separate until then, was incorporated into this segment. The company explains that this was aimed at creating synergies with FA components. The order intake of FUJI ELECTRIC CO.,LTD.'s Industry division on a standalone basis was ¥185.2 billion.

entries.e0c92e6ceb58f04e: This is a business not included in the reportable segments. Note 1 of the securities report states: 'The 'Other' category comprises business segments not included in the reportable segments and includes financial services, real estate, insurance agency, travel, and printing and information services.' The companies responsible are Fuji Electric Fias Co., Ltd. and Fuji Office & Life Service Co., Ltd.; the latter is the successor in form to Fuji Electric Home Appliances Co., Ltd., which was established in October 1966 to strengthen sales in the home appliance division. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, revenue from external customers was ¥38,154 million, segment profit was ¥3,865 million, and the number of employees was 1,487 (excluding 376 temporary employees). This category has a high proportion of work within the group; intersegment internal revenue or transfers in the same fiscal year amounted to ¥20,203 million. In addition, Metawater Co., Ltd. and Metawater Service Co., Ltd., which are engaged in water treatment, are equity-method affiliates of this segment.
